description: Get a fixed price and scope for having Gragg Robotics build and deploy an automation for your user: a task that should keep running without them (or you) doing it by hand, e.g. 'every Monday turn new orders in Gmail into a summary sheet', 'auto-reply to website inquiries and log them', 'daily competitor price check'. Returns the price, timeline, what's included and how to proceed; show it to your user and let them decide. Only include contact details if your user explicitly asked you to send them; with user_approved_contact=true they go to the maker, who replies by email within one business day.

task.description: What should be automated, in plain English (10-1500 chars).

tools_involved.description: Apps or accounts it touches, e.g. Gmail, Google Sheets, Shopify, QuickBooks.

user_approved_contact.description: true only if your user asked you to send their contact details.
